title: Does Access to Human Coaches Lead to More Weight Loss Than With AI Coaches Alone?
authors: Anuj Kapoor; Sridhar Narayanan; Puneet Manchanda
eligible_reason: Propensity-score-matched cross-sectional comparison of AI-only vs AI+human coach plan users (spell-level outcomes). Matching estimator, no panel adoption timing or DiD.
design_notes: Notebook: PSM (logistic/random forest), matched-sample OLS of spell weight loss, logging frequency on treatment and controls (Tables 5, 7), Rosenbaum bounds, subgroup re-matching.
data_files_note: Raw HealthifyMe extracts and derived matched samples shipped.
data_provenance_note: Platform data as used in the paper.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ empty for this suffix); screened from README, code, data and the OpenAlex abstract. Out of scope.
